tools.heading: Organiser tools
tools.opportunitiesHint: Everything this organisation has posted, with its shifts and who is coming.
tools.expensesHint: Approve, reject and pay what your volunteers have claimed.
tools.fundraisingHint: Run campaigns and confirm the money passed on to you.

opportunities.heading: Your opportunities
opportunities.intro: Everything this organisation has posted, including those closed to new volunteers and those cancelled.
opportunities.emptyOpen: No open opportunities. Post one to start finding volunteers.

deleteOpportunity.heading: Remove this opportunity
deleteOpportunity.hint: It disappears from the list and nobody new can apply. People already approved keep their record of the hours they gave.
deleteOpportunity.confirmMessage: It will no longer be shown to volunteers and its upcoming shifts will no longer be bookable. This cannot be undone from the app.
deleteOpportunity.doneMessage: Volunteers can no longer see or apply to it.

shifts.title: Shifts
shifts.intro: Volunteers sign up to a shift once their application is approved. Add single shifts, or set up repeating ones; repeating shifts are created 14 days ahead and topped up automatically.
shifts.notYoursTitle: You do not manage this opportunity
shifts.notYoursHint: Only the people who run it can see or change its shifts.
shifts.removeBody: {{count}} volunteers hold a place on it. They keep their application to this opportunity and will be told the shift has been cancelled.
shifts.removeBody_one: {{count}} volunteer holds a place on it. They keep their application to this opportunity and will be told the shift has been cancelled.
shifts.removeBodyNone: Nobody is signed up to it yet.
shifts.removedAffected: Shift removed. {{count}} volunteers have been told.
shifts.removedAffected_one: Shift removed. {{count}} volunteer has been told.
shifts.patternsOff: Repeating shifts are switched off for this community.
shifts.stopBody: Shifts that have not started yet will be removed and no more will be created. Shifts already underway or finished are kept.
shifts.patternStopped: Repeating shifts stopped. {{count}} upcoming shifts removed.
shifts.patternStopped_one: Repeating shifts stopped. {{count}} upcoming shift removed.
shifts.stopFailed: Could not stop the repeating shifts.

frequency.monthly: Every month, on the same date

shiftForm.subtitle: Volunteers approved for this opportunity can book a place on it.
shiftForm.editSubtitle: Changes only apply before the shift starts.

shiftForm.invalidTime: Enter times as HH:MM, for example 09:30.
shiftForm.endBeforeStart: The shift must end after it starts.
shiftForm.invalidPlaces: Enter a whole number of 1 or more.
shiftForm.reviewSubtitle: The shift is shown to approved volunteers straight away.
shiftForm.reviewMissing: Fill in the date, start and end before saving.

patternForm.intro: The individual shifts are created for you, 14 days ahead, and more are added as time passes.
patternForm.editIntro: Changing the days or times is applied to the upcoming shifts now. A shift that somebody has already booked is kept.
patternForm.required: Fill in the start date, start and end.
patternForm.invalidTime: Enter times as HH:MM, for example 09:30.
patternForm.endBeforeStart: The shift must end after it starts.
patternForm.endDateBeforeStart: The last shift must be on or after the first.
patternForm.invalidPlaces: Enter a whole number of 1 or more.
patternForm.created: Repeating shifts set up. {{count}} shifts created so far.
patternForm.created_one: Repeating shifts set up. {{count}} shift created so far.
patternForm.reconciled: Repeating shifts updated. Upcoming shifts removed: {{removed}}, kept: {{kept}}, added: {{generated}}.
patternForm.saveFailed: Could not save the repeating shifts.
patternForm.loadFailed: Could not load these repeating shifts.
patternForm.notFound: These repeating shifts no longer exist.
patternForm.reviewSubtitle: The first shifts are created as soon as you save.
patternForm.reviewMissing: Fill in the start date, start and end before saving.

expenses.title: Expense claims
expenses.intro: Expense claims your volunteers have submitted to this organisation. Approve or reject new claims, then mark approved claims as paid once you have paid them.
expenses.loadError: Could not load the expense claims.
expenses.notYoursTitle: You do not manage this organisation
expenses.notYoursHint: Only its owners and admins can review expense claims.
expenses.emptyPending: There are no claims waiting for review.
expenses.ownClaim: This is your own claim. Another organisation admin must review it.
expenses.receiptLabel: Open the receipt for the claim from {{name}}
expenses.receiptSharingUnavailable: Nothing on this device can open the receipt.
expenses.markPaidLabel: Mark the claim from {{name}} as paid
expenses.rejectNotesPlaceholder: Tell the volunteer why the claim was rejected
expenses.paidIntro: Only do this once the money has actually reached the volunteer.
expenses.paymentReferencePlaceholder: For example, a bank transfer reference
expenses.alreadyHandled: This claim has already been dealt with by someone else. The list has been refreshed.

fundraising.title: Fundraising
fundraising.intro: Campaigns you run here go live straight away and raise money for your organisation. Gifts are held by the community, which passes them on to you.
fundraising.empty: Your organisation has no fundraising campaigns yet.
fundraising.notYoursTitle: You do not manage this organisation
fundraising.notYoursHint: Only its owners and admins can run its fundraising.
fundraising.endMessage: Members will no longer be able to give to it.
fundraising.detailsError: Could not load the gifts and hand-overs.
fundraising.noHandovers: No money has been passed on yet.
fundraising.confirmReceivedMessage: Only confirm once {{amount}} has actually reached your organisation.
fundraising.noHistory: Nothing has been recorded for this campaign yet.

campaignForm.subtitle: The campaign goes live as soon as you save it.
campaignForm.editSubtitle: Changes are recorded in the campaign's history.
campaignForm.titlePlaceholder: What are you raising money for?
campaignForm.descriptionPlaceholder: Tell members what their gift will do.
campaignForm.required: Fill in the title, both dates and a goal.
campaignForm.endBeforeStart: The end date must be on or after the start date.
campaignForm.invalidGoal: Enter a goal greater than zero.
campaignForm.reviewSubtitle: Members can give to it straight away.
